quick_facts.sprint_goal: Complete the full Playwright E2E suite (Playwright was set up in Sprint 4 — this sprint closes all remaining E2E gaps). OWASP Top 10 security review with all findings addressed. Performance baseline established.

content.tldr: QA completion sprint. Playwright infrastructure was set up in Sprint 4 with P0 tests (cashier flow, auth flow). This sprint completes the remaining E2E flows for accountant, manager, admin. Security audit (OWASP Top 10). Load test baseline with autocannon/k6. Vitest coverage CI gate added.

features_committed.title: Playwright E2E Test Suite
features_committed.rationale: No automated regression safety net. A manual test-dependent system cannot go to production.

features_committed.title: Security Audit (OWASP Top 10)
features_committed.rationale: System handles financial data and Vietnamese tax records. Security is non-negotiable before production.
tasks: T119: A01 Broken Access Control — verify all endpoints have @Roles() guard (no missing guard audit)
T120: A02 Cryptography — verify bcrypt cost 12 in use, JWT secret entropy check (>= 256 bits)
T121: A03 Injection — verify all TypeORM queries use parameterized (no raw string concat in QueryBuilder)
T122: A05 Security Misconfiguration — helmet headers enabled, CORS whitelist tightened
T123: A06 Vulnerable Components — npm audit --audit-level=high on backend + frontend, fix all high/critical
T124: A07 Auth Failures — rate limiting on POST /auth/login (max 10/min/IP via @nestjs/throttler) + verify
T125: A09 Logging — ensure no passwords/tokens logged in Winston transports
T126: Security findings documented in wiki/decisions/ as a security-decision entry

also_this_sprint: Vitest coverage report: add --coverage flag, target >70% for services
Load test: autocannon 100 concurrent, 30s against POST /auth/login + GET /products — baseline documented
Fix any TypeScript strict-mode suppressions found during audit
